pretreatments.description: Mechanical treatment using a hammer mill to grind the raw material into ≤20 mm mesh sizes, followed by a thermal treatment at 80°C for 60 minutes using a CLIFTON 88579 water bath.
Chemical treatment using 3 g of NaOH for 100 g of Total Solid (TS) at 55°C for 24 hours, followed by a thermal treatment at 80°C for 60 minutes.
